name: In Favor of Elune
summary: In Shadowglen, young night elf priests set out for guidance and training in Dolanaar. Priestess Shanda sends them along the forest path to Laurna Morninglight.

sections.title: Leaving the Glade
sections.body: Priestess Shanda trains initiates who serve Elune in Aldrassil's secluded shelter. Under her eye, they begin with simple prayers and spells of defense. Yet Shadowglen's quiet life cannot prepare them for the turmoil beyond the glade. Once an initiate shows steady faith and discipline, Shanda sends them down the forest path to Dolanaar for further teaching.

sections.title: A Step Into the Priesthood
sections.body: In Dolanaar, a young night elf takes an important step in the service of Elune. Priestess Laurna Morninglight prepares her disciples for the trials facing Teldrassil. There, an acolyte can learn more advanced moonlit spellcraft and receive formal vestments. Those robes mark their place in the Sisterhood of Elune.

faq.q: Who sends me on this journey?
aliases: who starts in favor of elune
where do i get this quest
faq.answer: Priestess Shanda sends you from Aldrassil in Shadowglen once your first training is complete.

faq.q: Where do I need to go to find Laurna Morninglight?
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight is in Dolanaar's northern building. Dolanaar is the first major settlement south of the Shadowglen gates in Teldrassil.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
aliases: who can do in favor of elune
faq.answer: No. This is for young night elf priests taking their first steps in the Sisterhood and in service to Elune.

faq.q: What happens after I speak to Laurna Morninglight?
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight greets you and offers the trial Garments of the Moon. It tests your ability to protect and heal wounded defenders before she gives you your first official clerical robes.

faq.q: Is this quest mandatory to continue priest training?
aliases: do i have to do in favor of elune
can i skip in favor of elune
faq.answer: This introduction is optional. If you travel straight to Dolanaar, Laurna Morninglight still offers training and the steps that follow.

faq.q: Why is earning garments so important to the Sisterhood?
faq.answer: Vestments are sacred symbols in night elf culture. They mark a priest's station, devotion, and readiness to channel the Moon Goddess's blessings in service to their people.

angles.text: As a priest, you leave simple novitiate studies for fuller service and begin the path toward your first consecrated clerical vestments.
As a night elf, you follow a traditional milestone for devotees. The Sisterhood of Elune is the spiritual heart and historic leadership of kaldorei society.
